messages:
sam_support: FYI — customer 'acme-media' in prod hit a wave of decrypt failures right after key rotation at ~03:11 UTC. They see SDK retries then AccessDenied on Decrypt. Billing spike from retries. CloudTrail for the KMS key shows Encrypt/GenerateDataKey but I can't find any Decrypt events for tenant principal. copying logs:

sam_support: ```
2026-03-15T03:11:22Z ERROR KMSClient Decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: Access denied
  status=403 requestId=abcd-1234 tenant=tenant-123
  sdk.retry=3
```

maria_kms: Can you paste the exact Authorization principal used (role ARN) and whether we did alias swap or key rotation that changed key policy or grants? If key policy uses principal tags (aws:PrincipalTag/tenant-id) and STS session tags weren't propagated, KMS will deny.

sam_support: Role is arn:aws:sts::999999999999:assumed-role/ingress-proxy-role/session-abc. We did an alias->new-key alias swap as part of the rotation. The key policy did have a conditional on aws:PrincipalTag:tenant-id == tenant-123 (customer req). Customer claims they used our SDK through the proxy; they don't assume role directly.

kevin_security: Important: our ingress proxy calls AssumeRole then forwards requests to KMS using the assumed role creds. If the proxy isn't passing session tags or we're re-using long-lived creds instead of AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity/Tags, the principal won't carry the tenant tag. That would explain no Decrypt CloudTrail events tied to tenant-tag principal. Also check whether proxy is using `sts:TagSession` permission.

diane_support: Customer reported that after rotation some of their hosts started using a cached token until 03:20 UTC and then fallover to retries. They saw 403s from their app logs, then we see a short recovery. I opened a support case and told them we're investigating.

maria_kms: Repro checklist for on-call:
1) Capture a live proxy request/response (with headers) to confirm whether session-tags are present in the AssumeRole call.
2) Check CloudTrail for STS:AssumeRole events for ingress-proxy-role around 03:10-03:25 UTC for the tag set. Look for `sessionTags` in the event.
3) Check KMS key policy/condition block and grants for the new key ID to ensure they allow the assumed role if tags missing.

sam_support: quick grep from proxy logs shows we call STS AssumeRole without TagSpecifications in our older codepath:```
[ingress-proxy] 2026-03-15T03:10:58Z STS AssumeRole role=ingress-proxy-role session=session-abc tags=null
```
so yeah looks like tags were dropped.

kevin_security: That matches. Two mitigation options: 1) emergency rollback alias to previous key until we patch tag propagation, or 2) temporarily relax the key policy to not require tenant tag for that role (short-lived change + audit). Which is lower blast radius?

maria_kms: Rollback is safest if possible — we still have the prior key material and alias pointers if no re-encrypt was required. But if customer already re-encrypted data with the new key we may need option 2. Also ensure we add an explicit grant for ingress-proxy-role on the new key so tags are not required for the interim.

oncall_bot: INC created: INC-2026-1453 — "AcmeMedia decrypt 403 after key rotation". Pager duty runbook linked: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-rotation-fallback

diane_support: I've asked ops to validate whether alias rollback is feasible for this customer (checking re-encrypt status). ETA 20m. Customer updated with "we're actively investigating, may cause temporary read disruption, will update in 30m" :thumbsup:

kevin_security: If we go the policy-relax route: do NOT grant broad access. Add a scoped statement allowing the ingress-proxy-role Decrypt on that key while condition requiring sourceIp or a temporary tag. Log the change and create an IAM change ticket.

maria_kms: Postmortem actions (short list):
- Patch proxy to include session tags on AssumeRole (code PR ready, needs quick deploy)
- Add automated test that key rotation + alias swap maintains Decrypt path with tag-based policies
- Add audit alert if KMS Decrypt count for a key drops to 0 for a tenant while Encrypts continue

sam_support: Ops confirmed alias rollback would force customer-side re-encrypt in some cases; ops will try a scoped grant as interim. I'll coordinate the IAM change and notify customer when applied.

audit_bot: Audit note: created change request CHG-7890 to temporarily add grant; change must be logged with justification and TTL < 6 hours.

diane_support: I'll follow up with customer after grant applied. Closing loop once traffic returns to normal.

maria_kms: After this we should backfill a KMS integration checklist for teams using tenant-tag policies: ensure proxy supports TagSession, ensure key policy fallbacks, and unit tests for alias swap.

sam_support: Action items: sam_support apply scoped grant (now); maria_kms open PR to patch proxy; kevin_security review policy change; diane_support update customer. ETA 40m.
